title: Friend-or-Foe-Fremesis
description: The Fremesis, a mob aptly named "Your Friend, Your Nemesis," offers a risky encounter. When you approach it, the creature allows you trade your useless items for useful ones.
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee0f2d768def7302056b9499df2bab57e2960063_0.webp)

Fremesis is a unique, high-stakes entity mod for Minecraft that introduces a mysterious figure known as "Your Friend, Your Nemesis." This mod adds a layer of risk-reward strategy to your world through a volatile trading mechanic and a dynamic rage system.

Features
- The Tainted Exchange: Interact with the Fremesis to trade items from the "First Tier" pool. Every trade is a gamble, yielding unpredictable rewards from the "First Tier Output" loot table.
- The Rage Meter: Every deal has a cost. Trading with the Fremesis increases its internal rage. As its temper flares, it triggers dangerous environmental actions and summons hostile mobs that scale in intensity with its fury.
- Java-Based Animations: Experience fluid and eerie movements. The Fremesis features custom animations for walking, idling, and attacking, bringing a distinct personality to this enigmatic entity.
- Finite Presence: The Fremesis isn't here to stay. After five trades, the entity shuts down and vanishes from your world, leaving you to deal with the consequences of your bargains.

**Installation**
Fremesis is built for modern Minecraft versions.

- Ensure you have the correct version of your preferred mod loader installed.
- Download the Fremesis .jar file from the versions tab.
- Place the file into your mods folder.
- (Optional) For the best experience, ensure any required animation APIs are present in your instance.

Compatibility
Fremesis is designed to play well with others. By utilizing standardized item tags for its trading system, it can easily integrate with other mods that add custom loot or items.

This mod is currently in active development. If you encounter bugs or have suggestions for the Rage mechanic, please report them on the official issue tracker.
